posts.title: Five habits that make training stick
posts.excerpt: Small, repeatable habits beat big plans. Here are the five we see in every member who is still training a year later.
posts.author: Ravi Kulkarni
posts.body:
Motivation gets you through the door once. Habits get you through it every week.

## Book your sessions like meetings

Put your workouts in the calendar and treat them as fixed. The plan that survives a busy week is the one that is already scheduled.

> Show up on the days you do not feel like it, and the rest takes care of itself.

## Keep a simple log

Write down what you lifted. Seeing the numbers go up is the best reminder that it works.

- Train at the same time of day
- Sleep before you add more weight
- Ask your coach when something hurts
- Celebrate every small win

posts.title: How to choose fresh ingredients
posts.excerpt: A short guide to reading a market stall: what to smell, what to touch, and what to leave behind.
posts.author: Meera Nair
posts.body:
Good cooking starts before the stove is lit. It starts at the market.

## Use your nose first

Fresh produce smells of itself. If it smells of nothing, or of something sour, move on.

## Buy what is in season

Seasonal ingredients taste better and cost less. Ask the seller what came in this morning.
